title: Simplify /balances to pairwise balances (drop debt-minimization)
declaredInterface: GET /balances -> {net: {person: amount}, pairwise: [{from, to, amount}]} (replaces the greedy-minimized `settlements` list with direct pairwise net balances between each pair of people)
assumptions: User asked to replace the transaction-minimizing settle-up algorithm with straightforward pairwise balances (net debt between each pair of people who've shared an expense together), dropping simplifyDebts.
